insight: Bootstrapped by two indie founders, Podsqueeze reached $100K ARR within five months of launching.
name: Podsqueeze
tagline: Turn podcast episodes into show notes, clips, and posts in one click.
description: Podsqueeze is an AI assistant for podcasters that takes an episode and generates show notes, timestamps, titles, transcripts, newsletters, blog posts, and social clips automatically. It targets the post-production and promotion busywork that follows recording, repurposing a single upload into a full set of distribution assets. A bootstrapped indie product used by tens of thousands of podcasters and agencies.
edge: Purpose-built for podcast repurposing — one upload yields show notes, timestamps, clips, a newsletter, and social posts, not just a transcript.
pros: Many asset types from one episode
cons: Outputs need human editing and polish
